title: Professional Certificate in Stock Market Investment and Portfolio Management
description: The Professional Certificate in Stock Market Investment and Portfolio Management aims to enable the learner to understand the stock market and the different trading options available.
longDescription: Identify the tools of technical analysis Understand the industry life cycle Recognize the characteristics of industry analysis Identify market efficiency theory Understand security analysis and portfolio management Recognize the risk of the portfolio Identify pricing and discounting Understand the capital asset pricing model (CAPM) and the single-index Recognize arbitrage pricing theory (apt) and CAPM The Professional Certificate in Stock Market Investment and Portfolio Management aims to enable the learner to understand the stock market and the different trading options available there. The learner will be able to weigh different investment options in stocks and will be equipped with the knowledge and skills of managing the investment portfolio.
